comment: The panel prints STRUCT, MORPH, ATK, DEC, SUS, LPG, FM, V/OCT and GATE, with a hash mark by the partial count knob and a keyboard graphic by the algorithm knob; the four-letter display above shows the current algorithm's own tag. src/Organism.cpp:88 calls configInput on SPECIMEN_CV_INPUT a second time with the name 'Gate', which overwrites that jack's real name and leaves the gate jack with no name at all, so Rack's tooltips on those two jacks are wrong and missing respectively. The maker's manual names the expander Domesticate; the panel and the slug both say O-Tamer. The fourteen algorithms are Basic, Organ, Low Quality, Fish, Combed Saw, Metallic, Keys, Fractal-ish, Particles, Prism, Chaotic, Noise, Phase Mod and Per-Partial AM.
